**Privacy & Data Security:**

• **Zero Student Data Storage:** We never store student names, grades, or personal information
• **FERPA & GDPR Compliant:** Full compliance with education privacy laws
• **End-to-End Encryption:** All communications secured
• **EU-Based Servers:** Data processed in European Union
• **Regular Security Audits:** Quarterly third-party security reviews

**Getting Help:**

• **Email Support:** help@zazapromptly.com (24-48hr response)
• **FAQ Section:** Comprehensive help articles
• **Video Tutorials:** Step-by-step guides
• **Live Chat:** Available during EU business hours
• **Community Forum:** Connect with other teachers

**Technical Requirements:**

• **Browser:** Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge (latest versions)
• **Internet:** Basic broadband connection
• **No Downloads:** Fully web-based, works on any device
• **Mobile Friendly:** Optimized for phones and tablets
• **Offline Mode:** Basic templates available without internet
